Oostende|Oostende]] | years4 = 2024 | team4 = [[Karşıyaka Basket|Karşıyaka]] | years5 = 2025–2026 | team5 = [[ASK Karditsas B.C.|Karditsa]] | years6 = 2026–present | team6 = [[Bandırma Bordo Basketbol]] | highlights = * [[BNXT League]] champion (2024) * [[List of Belgian basketball champions|Belgian League]] champion (2024) * [[BNXT Supercup]] winner (2023) * [[BNXT League Most Valuable Player|BNXT League MVP]] (2024) * [[BNXT League Finals MVP]] (2024) * [[BNXT League National Finals MVP|BNXT Belgian Finals MVP]] (2024) * [[BNXT League Dream Team]] ([[2023–24 BNXT League|2024]]) * Second-team [[List of All-Big East Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big East]] (2021) }} '''Damien Jefferson''' (born October 3, 1997) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Bandırma Bordo Basketbol|Pizza Bulls Bordo Bandırma]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[New Mexico Lobos men's basketball|New Mexico Lobos]] and the [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton Bluejays]]. ==Early life== Jefferson attended [[Central High School (East Chicago, Indiana)|Central High School]] in [[East Chicago, Indiana]]. As a senior, he averaged 26.1 points and 8.1 rebounds per game and was named ''[[The Times of Northwest Indiana]]'' Player of the Year.{{cite web |last1=Hanlon |first1=Steve |title=Times Boys Basketball Player of the Year: Damien Jefferson, E.C. Central |url=https://www.nwitimes.com/sports/high-school/boys-basketball/times-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year-damien-jefferson-e-c-central/article_481cedae-c4d4-5330-a75a-28ae9d00cb74.html |website=[[The Times of Northwest Indiana]] |access-date=March 23, 2021 |date=March 31, 2016}} Jefferson led his team to a Class 4A sectional title and was named an Indiana All-Star.{{cite web |last1=Boyd |first1=James |title=EC Central grad, Creighton forward Damien Jefferson declares for NBA Draft |url=https://www.nwitimes.com/high-school/ec-central-grad-creighton-forward-damien-jefferson-declares-for-nba-draft/article_29bfbadf-4a04-508e-9981-aed2e4dc66ca.html |website=[[The Times of Northwest Indiana]] |access-date=March 23, 2021 |date=April 30, 2020}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[New Mexico Lobos men's basketball|New Mexico]], his father's alma mater.{{cite web |last1=Hanlon |first1=Steve |title=E.C. Central's Damien Jefferson visits New Mexico, verbally commits to play for the Lobos |url=https://www.nwitimes.com/sports/high-school/e-c-centrals-damien-jefferson-visits-new-mexico-verbally-commits-to-play-for-the-lobos/article_b99017ad-4c6e-5042-a826-8d662b5fc54e.html |website=[[The Times of Northwest Indiana]] |access-date=March 23, 2021 |date=September 21, 2015}} ==College career== Jefferson averaged 5.3 points and 2.3 rebounds as a freshman at New Mexico. For his sophomore season, he transferred to [[Creighton Bluejays men's basketball|Creighton]] and sat out for one year due to transfer rules.{{cite web |last1=Nyatawa |first1=Jon |title=Former New Mexico guard Damien Jefferson announces he'll transfer to Creighton |url=https://omaha.com/sports/college/creighton/former-new-mexico-guard-damien-jefferson-announces-hell-transfer-to-creighton/article_3471c1fc-578d-11e7-8b9b-876e5b653499.html |website=[[Omaha World-Herald]] |access-date=March 23, 2021 |date=June 22, 2017}} As a sophomore, Jefferson averaged 6.2 points and four rebounds per game before his season was cut short due to a high ankle sprain injury.{{cite web |title=Damien Jefferson – 2020-21 – Men's Basketball |url=https://gocreighton.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/damien-jefferson/6829 |website=Creighton University Athletics |access-date=March 23, 2021}} In his junior season, he averaged 9.4 points and 5.5 rebounds per game. Jefferson declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]] before withdrawing and returning to college.{{cite web |last1=Ferguson |first1=Aaron |title=East Chicago's Damien Jefferson withdraws from NBA Draft, returns to Creighton |url=https://www.nwitimes.com/sports/east-chicagos-damien-jefferson-withdraws-from-nba-draft-returns-to-creighton/article_e49bc603-de87-5eb9-aab4-9abd11b06430.html |website=[[The Times of Northwest Indiana]] |access-date=March 23, 2021 |date=August 1, 2020}} On December 17, 2020, he flirted with a [[triple-double]], recording 10 points, 10 rebounds and eight assists in a 94–76 win over [[St. John's Red Storm men's basketball|St. John's]].{{cite web |last1=DeMarinis |first1=Matt |title=Damien Jefferson is proving that he doesn’t need a spotlight in order to shine |url=https://whiteandbluereview.com/damien-jefferson-is-proving-that-he-doesnt-need-a-spotlight-in-order-to-shine/ |website=White & Blue Review |access-date=March 23, 2021 |date=December 18, 2020}} As a senior, Jefferson earned Second Team All-[[Big East Conference|Big East]] honors.{{cite web |last1=Nyatawa |first1=Jon |title=Creighton's Marcus Zegarowski, Damien Jefferson and Denzel Mahoney earn Big East honors |url=https://omaha.com/sports/college/creighton/creightons-marcus-zegarowski-damien-jefferson-and-denzel-mahoney-earn-big-east-honors/article_6cd738f6-7f9d-11eb-b042-a3d5ae25f5c1.html |website=[[Omaha World-Herald]] |access-date=March 23, 2021 |date=March 7, 2021}} He averaged 11.9 points and 5.4 rebounds per game. Jefferson declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]], forgoing an additional season of eligibility the NCAA granted due to the COVID-19 pandemic.{{cite web |last1=Goodman |first1=Jeff |title=Stadium’s 2021 NBA Draft Entry Tracker |url=https://watchstadium.com/stadiums-2021-nba-draft-entry-tracker-05-03-2021/ |website=WatchStadium.com |access-date=October 8, 2021 |date=May 3, 2021}} ==Professional career== Jefferson joined the [[Sacramento Kings]] for the [[2021 NBA Summer League]], winning a summer league championship.{{cite web|first=Sam|last=Westrick|title=Damien Jefferson is NBA Summer League Champion|url=https://247sports.com/college/creighton/Article/Damien-Jefferson-is-NBA-Summer-League-Champion-169294981/|website=247Sports.com|date=August 18, 2021|access-date=October 8, 2021}} He joined the [[Stockton Kings]] as an affiliate player on October 25, 2021,{{cite web|title=Stockton Kings Announce 2021-22 Training Camp Roster|url=https://stockton.gleague.nba.com/news/stockton-kings-announce-2021-22-training-camp-roster/|website=NBA.com|date=October 25, 2021|access-date=November 2, 2021}} but was later waived on January 29, 2022. He was acquired by the [[Memphis Hustle]] on February 14.{{cite web|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=NBA.com|date=February 14, 2022|access-date=February 15, 2022}} On July 31, 2023, Jefferson signed with [[B.C. Oostende|Filou Oostende]] of the [[BNXT League]].{{cite web|title=NEW PLAYER ANNOUNCEMENT|url=https://bcoostende.be/nieuws/new-player-announcement/|website=BCOostende.be|date=July 31, 2023|access-date=July 31, 2023}} On August 11, 2024, he signed with [[Karşıyaka Basket]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{Cite tweet |user=KSKBasket |number=1819013125158371402 |title=Damien Jefferson Pınar Karşıyaka’mızda!}} On August 8, 2025, Jefferson signed with Greek club [[ASK Karditsas B.C.|Karditsa]].{{Cite web |title=Damien Jefferson signed with Karditsa Iaponiki and returns to the BCL - Eurohoops |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fiba-champions-league/1855308/damien-jefferson-signed-with-karditsa-iaponiki-and-returns-to-the-bcl/ |access-date=2025-08-09 |website=www.eurohoops.net}} On July 2, 2026, he signed with [[Bandırma Bordo Basketbol]] of the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL).{{Cite Instagram |user=bandirmabordobasketbol |postid=DaSKnnFKqQZ
